description: This file implements a class and functions for traversing and modifying an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) to replace problematic pow() calls with equivalent expressions, specifically converting pow(x, y) where y is a constant into exp2(y * log2(x)). It is part of a shader compiler or translator, likely related to ANGLE project.

classes.name: RemovePowTraverser
classes.description: A class that traverses an AST to identify and replace pow() calls where the exponent is a constant, converting them into exp2(y * log2(x)).

methods.name: IsProblematicPow
methods.description: Checks if a node represents a pow() call with a constant exponent.

methods.name: RemovePowTraverser::RemovePowTraverser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the traverser with a symbol table.

methods.name: RemovePowTraverser::visitAggregate
methods.description: Visits aggregate nodes to identify and replace problematic pow() calls.

methods.name: RemovePow
methods.description: Main function that applies the traverser to the AST, iterating until all problematic pow() calls are replaced.
